title: Snooker Scorekeeper
shortDescription: Simple, fast snooker scoring — fully offline.
fullDescription:
A clean, intuitive snooker scorekeeping app designed for real matches. No ads, no tracking, no internet required.

Features:
• Score tracking for up to 4 players
• Automatic foul penalty calculation
• Endgame scoring with re-spot black
• Free ball support
• Shot missed tracking with undo
• Multiple reds scoring (long press)
• Match history with player statistics
• Highest break tracking per player
• Timer display for match and turn duration
• Google Sign-In support
• Dark theme optimized for table-side use
• Multi-language support
• No ads, no data collection, no internet required

Perfect for casual games, club matches, or practice sessions.
